Lever Talent Fit.weights_or_ranking: ranked candidates with transparent scoring and stated explanations of why matches stand out, plus gap identification for interview prep; exact scoring formula unstated

Manatal.weights_or_ranking: distinguishes required criteria (non-negotiable, stronger influence) from preferred criteria (nice-to-have, lighter weighting), up to 10 total criteria per job; a separate 'Job Completion Score' (bars, grade B/A = 4-5 bars) gates whether AI recommendations unlock, based on JD length and salary/location fields being filled

fields_extracted: job requirements (exact fields not publicly disclosed)

fields_extracted: up to 6 manually defined criteria per job
Recruitee.weights_or_ranking: recommends only candidates meeting at least 75% of job requirements; ignores sensitive information (names, age, contact details, social media links, gender, nationality); per-criterion weighting unstated

SeekOut.weights_or_ranking: recommends a 1-5 point scoring scale with defined thresholds (high = strong direct experience, mid = partial alignment, low = limited alignment); rubrics should separate must-haves (non-negotiable), nice-to-haves (preferred), and bonus points (extra top-tier indicators)

Teamtailor Co-pilot.weights_or_ranking: three-level system per criterion: meets criteria / doesn't meet criteria / unknown; no numeric weighting stated

Workable Agent.weights_or_ranking: scoring considers completeness of candidate profile (CV + application answers), data validity/consistency, criterion complexity, and alignment between candidate information and requirements; exact weighting formula unstated
